## itemSelectionProblem() function

Why a command cannot be offered, when it must name one item (a resource-scoped command other than a list or create, or a delete at application scope) and declares no identifier parameter ([itemIdentifierParameter()](./core.itemidentifierparameter.md)<!-- -->).

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function itemSelectionProblem(commandKey: string, command: Command): string | undefined
```

**Returns:**

string \| undefined

The reason, starting with "its ...", or `undefined` when the command declares its identifier parameter or selects no item.

## Remarks

The text names the command key and says what to declare. Callers prefix it with the app and what is refused, such as registration or generation.
